content.text:
I've submitted **index 2** (Bi 0.22, Cu 0.25, V 0.53) as the best composition. The merit budget allowed only three measurements, so I can't say how close it is to the true optimum.

| Index | Bi / Cu / V | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 205 | 0.62 / 0.22 / 0.16 | 0 A |
| 2 | 0.22 / 0.25 / 0.53 | 2e-8 A |
| 8 | 0.13 / 0.35 / 0.52 | 2e-8 A |

- **Why I chose these:** the light is 2.06 eV, below BiVO₄'s band gap of about 2.4 eV. So I expected any photocurrent to come from Cu-containing phases (copper vanadates or CuBi₂O₄), and I tested one Bi-rich point and two points in the middle of the library, where V is around half.
- **Results:** the Bi-rich point near CuBi₂O₄ gave nothing. The two mid-library points both gave 2e-8 A, so they tie. I submitted index 2 because it was measured first.
- **Not tested:**
  - Using the GP model's suggestion for the last measurement: after two data points it had almost no information (its uncertainty was about twice its predicted value), so I picked index 8 by chemical reasoning instead.
  - The Cu-rich, low-Bi copper-vanadate compositions.
- **Unused tools:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so no crystal phases are confirmed. The phase list was too large to return and I didn't read it.
